hooks.text: 被困监狱地狱的橙子被迫参加致命游戏，只为争取被运往更安全的市场
hooks.excerpt: Trapped in a prison hell, a desperate orange will play a deadly game in the hopes of getting shipped to safer markets.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 香蕉枪拥有六个膛室，但成熟时只会在其中一个随机膛室长出爆炸种荚
hooks.excerpt: The Banana Gun has six chambers. A single seed pod forms in a single chamber as the Banana Gun ripens.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 成熟香蕉枪会自行转轮击发，玩家也能手动扣动，但需剥开枪口避免回火
hooks.excerpt: When it has reached full development, under a bright sun, the Banana Gun begins to 'trigger' itself, cycling its cylinder counterclockwise until it reaches the random chamber the explosive seed pod is in. When that happens, seeds and banana fruit expel at high velocity, and can be deadly if you are in range. You can also pull their 'trigger' yourself with the same effect. If you intend to use the Banana Gun in this fashion, it is recommended to peel back the end of the 'muzzle' slightly, to prevent a backfire.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
